attempts.diagnosis: The handler only deduplicated on event.id, and only recorded the event after `await fulfillOrder`. Overlapping deliveries all passed the check before any of them recorded, so each one fulfilled. Events with different IDs for the same order were never deduplicated. Each delivery fulfilled the order again, including redeliveries after success.
attempts.changeSummary: Idempotency is now keyed on order_id instead of event.id. A `fulfilledOrders` set records only orders whose fulfillment has succeeded. An `inFlight` map holds one shared promise per order, so concurrent deliveries wait on a single fulfillOrder call and the others report 'duplicate'. If fulfillOrder throws, the order is not recorded and the in-flight entry is cleared. The error propagates to the owner and to any waiters, so a later retry can fulfill exactly once. A missing order_id throws instead of being acknowledged.
